Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:

Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Pharma / Biopharma Industry

Your Responsibilities:

● Performance & Web: End-to-end management and optimization of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and SEO (WordPress).

● Lead Pipeline: Structured qualification and handoff of marketing leads to our international sales team.

● Content: Creation of white papers, case studies, and web content tailored for B2B decision-makers.

● Budget & ROI: Ongoing monitoring and tracking of all campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experience: At least 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B digital marketing—preferably within an industrial, technical, or life sciences background.

● Tech Stack: Demonstrated proficiency with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, WordPress, and CRM platforms.

● Mindset: Strong technical aptitude to translate complex concepts into high-impact content.

● Languages: Native or full professional fluency in English (primary working language) alongside strong business-level German.

● Project Management: Proven ability to manage budgets, meet complex deadlines, and execute international trade show projects seamlessly.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.

Stellenbeschreibung

As a Hospitality Agent Front Office at The Cloud One Hotels, you embody the crucial role of being the initial point of contact for our guests, setting the tone with your appearance, whether it's extending a warm welcome at the reception or providing assistance over the phone from the front desk. - Guiding and supporting our guests seamlessly from check-in to check-out
- Enriching guest experiences by sharing insights and tips about the city and its surrounding areas
- Engaging in effective communication with guests via phone and email, adeptly managing reservation inquiries and navigating through overbooking situations and alternative options
- Handling invoices, including cost coverage management, cash handling, and settlement procedures
- Organizational and administrative responsibilities across both the front and back-office areas
- Expanding your knowledge through collaborative interactions within our multicultural team, offering insights into various cross-departmental roles

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.

- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.

Qualifikationen

Whether you're a professional in the hospitality industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:

- Educational background and/or professional experience in hospitality, gastronomy, tourism, or a keen interest in venturing into these fields
- Strong hosting expertise combined with an unwavering commitment to quality and service excellence
- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication
- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments
- Enthusiasm to actively contribute towards the successful establishment of The Cloud One Hotels across Europe

Be part of our team!

1 Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner Tasks
As a Senior Consultant focused on product management at Trinsik, you own digital products end-to-end - from blank page to live, growing product. In our venture-building teams, you turn client and user needs into a clear product vision, validate fast, and lead cross-functional teams to ship.

What You'll Do
 * Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
 * Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones
 * Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively
 * Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks
 * Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
 * Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration
 * Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work
 * Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targets

Requirements
 * Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement
 * Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps
 * 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products
 * Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number
 * Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence
 * A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide
 * High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief
 * Strong stakeholder management with senior stakeholders and clients, written and verbal, in German and English
 * A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
 * Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting
 * Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures)
 * Product marketing or positioning background
 * Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)

Benefits
The Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible hours and home office to balance life while keeping a vibrant team dynamic.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere in the EU, up to 20 calendar days/year, or use sabbatical options.

Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps and digital solutions with plenty of creative freedom.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.
